# Radian

> Radian is an open-source React UI component library and design system built on Radix Primitives and Tailwind CSS. It uses an open code system — components are copied directly into your codebase via CLI, giving you full ownership and customization. Currently supports Next.js (with Vite support available). TypeScript-native, with a companion Figma design system.

Radian is currently in alpha. Components are installed via `npx radianui@latest add [component]` and live in your project at `@/components/ui/`. New projects can be scaffolded with `npx radianui@latest init`. All components use Radian's semantic color tokens (e.g. `bg-bg`, `text-fg`, `border-border`, `text-primary-text`) defined as CSS custom properties in OKLCH format in your `globals.css`. Dark mode is built-in via a `.dark` class. Default fonts are Inter (body) and Geist (headings), configurable via `--body-font` and `--heading-font` CSS variables.

When generating code with Radian components: import from `@/components/ui/[component]`. Use the `color` prop for semantic colors (primary, neutral, error, success, info, warning) and the `variant` prop for visual styles (strong, soft, outline, ghost, link, glossy, smooth). Most components accept standard Tailwind classes for additional styling. Use `asChild` to render a component as a different element (e.g. wrapping a Next.js `<Link>`).

Key dependencies: Radix UI primitives, Tailwind CSS, lucide-react for icons, react-hook-form + zod for form validation, date-fns for date formatting, sonner for toasts, embla-carousel for carousels, vaul for drawers, cmdk for command palette, react-day-picker for calendar, shiki for syntax highlighting, react-international-phone for phone inputs, react-currency-input-field for currency inputs.

---

## CLI

Initialize a new project:
```bash
npx radianui@latest init
```

Add a component:
```bash
npx radianui@latest add [component]
```

Add all components:
```bash
npx radianui@latest add --all
```

---

## Color System

Colors are organized by usage. The main semantic tokens:

Background: `bg-bg`, `bg-fill1`, `bg-fill2`, `bg-fill3`, `bg-fill4`
Text: `text-fg`, `text-fg-secondary`, `text-fg-tertiary`, `text-fg-disabled`, `text-fg-inverse`
Border: `border-border`, `border-soft`, `border-alpha`, `border-soft-alpha`
Elevation: `bg-elevation-negative`, `bg-elevation-level1`, `bg-elevation-level2`
Utility: `white-inverse`, `black-inverse`

Each semantic color (primary, success, error, warning, info) has sub-tokens: `key`, `accent`, `focus`, `border`, `hover`, `text`. For example: `bg-primary`, `bg-primary-accent`, `text-primary-text`, `border-primary-border`.

Alpha variants are also available: `bg-fill1-alpha`, `bg-fill2-alpha`, `bg-fill3-alpha`, `bg-fill4-alpha`.

Dark mode is activated by adding the `.dark` class. All tokens auto-switch.

---

## Typography

Default fonts: Inter (body, `--body-font`), Geist (headings, `--heading-font`).

Utility classes: `heading-1` through `heading-6` (responsive), `body-15`, `text-sm-p`, `body-13`.
Font classes: `font-heading`, `font-body`.

To change fonts, override CSS variables in `globals.css`:
```css
body {
  --heading-font: "Your Heading Font", system-ui, sans-serif;
  --body-font: "Your Body Font", system-ui, sans-serif;
}
```

---

## Accordion

Install: `npx radianui@latest add accordion`
Dependency: `@radix-ui/react-accordion`

```tsx
import { Accordion, AccordionContent, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger } from "@/components/ui/accordion"
```

```tsx
<Accordion type="single" collapsible>
  <AccordionItem value="item-1">
    <AccordionTrigger>First Item</AccordionTrigger>
    <AccordionContent>Content of the first item.</AccordionContent>
  </AccordionItem>
</Accordion>
```

Variants: default, `variant="open"`, `variant="table"`. Sizes: default, small.

---

## Alert

Install: `npx radianui@latest add alert`

```tsx
import { Alert, AlertContent, AlertDescription, AlertIcon, AlertTitle, AlertToolbar } from "@/components/ui/alert"
```

```tsx
<Alert color="success">
  <AlertIcon><CircleCheckBig size={20} /></AlertIcon>
  <AlertContent>
    <AlertTitle>Payment Successful</AlertTitle>
    <AlertDescription>Your payment has been transferred.</AlertDescription>
  </AlertContent>
</Alert>
```

Colors: primary, success, error, warning, info, neutral. Variants: strong, soft, outline.
Supports `close` prop with `onClose` handler for dismissible alerts.

---

## Alert Dialog

Install: `npx radianui@latest add alert-dialog`
Dependency: `@radix-ui/react-alert-dialog`

```tsx
import { AlertDialog, AlertDialogAction, AlertDialogCancel, AlertDialogContent, AlertDialogDescription, AlertDialogFooter, AlertDialogHeader, AlertDialogTitle, AlertDialogTrigger } from "@/components/ui/alert-dialog"
```

```tsx
<AlertDialog>
  <AlertDialogTrigger asChild>
    <Button variant="outline" color="neutral">Show Dialog</Button>
  </AlertDialogTrigger>
  <AlertDialogContent className="max-w-100">
    <AlertDialogHeader>
      <AlertDialogTitle>Unsaved Changes</AlertDialogTitle>
      <AlertDialogDescription>Do you want to save or discard?</AlertDialogDescription>
    </AlertDialogHeader>
    <AlertDialogFooter>
      <AlertDialogCancel asChild><Button variant="outline" color="neutral">Discard</Button></AlertDialogCancel>
      <AlertDialogAction asChild><Button>Save Changes</Button></AlertDialogAction>
    </AlertDialogFooter>
  </AlertDialogContent>
</AlertDialog>
```

## Avatar

## Button

Install: `npx radianui@latest add button`
Dependency: `@radix-ui/react-slot`

```tsx
import { Button, ButtonGroup, CompactButton, IconButton } from "@/components/ui/button"
```

```tsx
<Button>Click Me</Button>
<Button variant="outline" color="neutral">Cancel</Button>
<Button color="error" variant="soft">Delete</Button>
<Button variant="glossy">Glossy</Button>

<IconButton aria-label="Settings" color="neutral" variant="outline"><Settings /></IconButton>

<CompactButton size="20" variant="outline" color="neutral"><ChevronDown /></CompactButton>

<ButtonGroup>
  <Button>Day</Button>
  <Button>Week</Button>
  <Button>Month</Button>
</ButtonGroup>
```

Variants: strong (default), soft, outline, ghost, link, glossy, glossy-inverted, smooth, smooth-inverted.
Colors: primary (default), neutral, error, success, info, warning.
Sizes: "28", "32", "36", "40", "44", "48".
Props: `loading` (shows spinner), `disabled`, `asChild` (polymorphic).

## Combobox

Install: `npx radianui@latest add combobox`
Uses Command + Popover internally.

```tsx
import { Command, CommandEmpty, CommandGroup, CommandInput, CommandItem, CommandList } from "@/components/ui/command"
import { Popover, PopoverContent, PopoverTrigger } from "@/components/ui/popover"
```

Pattern: Popover trigger (Button) → PopoverContent → Command with CommandInput, CommandList, CommandGroup, CommandItem.

## Date Picker

Install: `npx radianui@latest add date-picker`
Uses Calendar + Popover + date-fns internally.

```tsx
import { Calendar } from "@/components/ui/calendar"
import { Popover, PopoverContent, PopoverTrigger } from "@/components/ui/popover"
```

```tsx
const [date, setDate] = useState<Date>()

<Popover>
  <PopoverTrigger asChild>
    <Button variant="outline" color="neutral">
      {date ? format(date, "PPP") : "Pick a date"}
      <CalendarIcon className="ml-auto size-4" />
    </Button>
  </PopoverTrigger>
  <PopoverContent className="w-auto p-0">
    <Calendar mode="single" selected={date} onSelect={setDate} />
  </PopoverContent>
</Popover>
```

## Drawer

Install: `npx radianui@latest add drawer`
Dependency: `vaul`

```tsx
import { Drawer, DrawerBody, DrawerClose, DrawerContent, DrawerDescription, DrawerFooter, DrawerHeader, DrawerTitle, DrawerTrigger } from "@/components/ui/drawer"
```

```tsx
<Drawer variant="default" direction="right" handle={false} backdrop="overlay">
  <DrawerTrigger><Button>Open</Button></DrawerTrigger>
  <DrawerContent>
    <DrawerHeader>
      <DrawerTitle>Title</DrawerTitle>
      <DrawerDescription>Description</DrawerDescription>
    </DrawerHeader>
    <DrawerBody>Content</DrawerBody>
    <DrawerFooter>
      <DrawerClose asChild><Button variant="outline">Close</Button></DrawerClose>
    </DrawerFooter>
  </DrawerContent>
</Drawer>
```

Props: `direction` ("right", "left", "top", "bottom"), `backdrop` ("overlay", "blur"), `handle` (boolean).

## Form

Install: `npx radianui@latest add form`
Dependencies: `@radix-ui/react-slot`, `react-hook-form`, `zod`, `@hookform/resolvers`

```tsx
import { Form, FormControl, FormDescription, FormField, FormItem, FormLabel, FormMessage } from "@/components/ui/form"
```

```tsx
const FormSchema = z.object({
  email: z.string().check(z.email("Please enter a valid email.")),
})

const form = useForm<z.infer<typeof FormSchema>>({
  resolver: zodResolver(FormSchema),
  defaultValues: { email: "" },
})

<Form {...form}>
  <form onSubmit={form.handleSubmit(onSubmit)}>
    <FormField
      control={form.control}
      name="email"
      render={({ field }) => (
        <FormItem>
          <FormLabel>Email</FormLabel>
          <FormControl><Input placeholder="Email address" {...field} /></FormControl>
          <FormMessage />
        </FormItem>
      )}
    />
    <Button type="submit">Submit</Button>
  </form>
</Form>
```

## Sonner (Toast)

Install: `npm install sonner`
Requires wrapping app with `<Toaster />` from sonner in layout.

```tsx
import { toast } from "sonner"
```

```tsx
toast("Toast Title", {
  description: "Description message",
  action: {
    label: "Undo",
    onClick: () => console.log("Undo"),
  },
})
```

Setup in layout:
```tsx
import { Toaster } from "sonner"
// In your layout's <body>:
<Toaster />
```

```tsx
  </TableHeader>
  <TableBody>
    <TableRow>
      <TableCell>Sarah Chen</TableCell>
      <TableCell>sarah@company.com</TableCell>
      <TableCell><Badge color="success">Active</Badge></TableCell>
    </TableRow>
  </TableBody>
</Table>
```

---

## Tabs

Install: `npx radianui@latest add tabs`
Dependency: `@radix-ui/react-tabs`

```tsx
import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from "@/components/ui/tabs"
```

```tsx
<Tabs defaultValue="products">
  <TabsList>
    <TabsTrigger value="products">Products</TabsTrigger>
    <TabsTrigger value="orders">Orders</TabsTrigger>
  </TabsList>
  <TabsContent value="products">Products content</TabsContent>
  <TabsContent value="orders">Orders content</TabsContent>
</Tabs>
```

---

## Text Area

Install: `npx radianui@latest add text-area`

```tsx
import { TextArea } from "@/components/ui/text-area"
```

```tsx
<TextArea placeholder="Type your message here..." />
```

---

## Tooltip

Install: `npx radianui@latest add tooltip`
Dependency: `@radix-ui/react-tooltip`

```tsx
import { Tooltip, TooltipContent, TooltipTrigger } from "@/components/ui/tooltip"
```

```tsx
<Tooltip>
  <TooltipTrigger asChild>
    <Button color="neutral" variant="outline">Hover me</Button>
  </TooltipTrigger>
  <TooltipContent>
    <p>Tooltip description text.</p>
  </TooltipContent>
</Tooltip>
```
